audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2 and 3 were marked Singed while the page's own prose says the opposite — spikes[0] is titled 'Lvl 2-3' and describes Heroic Charge halting your pattern, whys[1] says she stuns you mid-run, whys[2] says she can kill you.
audit.why: Heroic Charge (14s at rank 1) into a wall is a full stun and Singed has no dash to answer it; before Rylai's he cannot punish her for landing it. The packet level chart also reads Poppy at 2 and 3.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one group: win[1] and win[2] to Poppy, with the matching phases[1].side and phases[2].side.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers and the page never noted that Hammer Shock's cooldown collapses to 4s.
audit.why: Hammer Shock is 8/7/6/5/4s, Heroic Charge 14/13/12/11/10s, Steadfast Presence 20/18/16/14/12s, Keeper's Verdict 140/120/100s. Heroic Charge at 14s is the window; a maxed Hammer Shock at 4s is effectively permanent zone damage.
audit.corrected: Real rank-1 numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page said Fling cancels Keeper's Verdict, and dontsFull[1] ('Get R-knocked away') treated her ult as unavoidable.
audit.why: Riot: 'Poppy channels a hammer strike that knocks enemies very far away' — the kit flags it channel, 'interruptible — any CC cancels it', and untargetable during the wind-up. Fling is a knockup, so it ends the channel outright. This is the single highest-value interaction in the matchup and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Written into dosFull[2], dontsFull[1], breakdown.cooldowns and spikes[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] claims she chains 'Q knockup into E wall-stun'. Hammer Shock has no knockup.
audit.why: Riot: Hammer Shock 'creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay' — it slows and grounds, it does not displace. The chain she actually has is Heroic Charge into the wall, with Hammer Shock as the slow that keeps you there.
audit.corrected: whys[2] restated with the real Q behaviour.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings call Iron Ambassador an automatic 'passive shield' she stacks each trade.
audit.why: Riot: 'Poppy throws her buckler that bounces off the target. Poppy can pick it up to gain a temporary shield.' The shield only exists if she walks to the buckler — which means you can stand on it or poison the ground around it and deny it.
audit.corrected: whys[0] and wants.foe[1] corrected; the pickup denial written in as an actionable line.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3], whys[6] and spikes[3] all spend their words on Steadfast Presence doing nothing — a non-interaction.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence is not dead against you: it passively gives armour and MR that scale up as she drops low, so poisoning her toward execute range makes her tankier, and the active gives her move speed to chase. That is the part that matters and it was never said.
audit.corrected: whys[6] and spikes[3] rewritten around the low-health resistances instead of the dash-block that never fires.

edits.before: Fling + glue starts punishing anyone who chases. Only take the trade when Poppy's Heroic Charge is down.
edits.after: Heroic Charge lands at 2 — a wall pin is a full stun and you have no dash out. Do nothing until its 14s is spent.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Poppy must walk into your range.
edits.after: Her full kit is live and Hammer Shock keeps you in the wall-stun. Hug lane centre so Heroic Charge finds no wall.

edits.before: Both level-1 kits are short-ranged melee — Poppy's passive shield eats your Poison Trail tick and you have no reliable way to force a trade before Fling unlocks.
edits.after: Both level-1 kits are short-ranged melee — Iron Ambassador's buckler shields her only if she picks it up, so stand on it and she trades without it.

edits.before: Her full kit is online and she can chain Q knockup into E wall-stun on short cooldowns, enough to kill you if she catches you near terrain before you have Rylai's slow.
edits.after: Her full kit is online: Heroic Charge pins you to the wall and Hammer Shock's zone slows you in place, enough to kill you near terrain before you have Rylai's.

edits.before: Two items in, her Steadfast Presence never fires and her only stop is Heroic Charge into a wall — run open-lane patterns and your split-push engine is effectively unanswerable for a solo Poppy.
edits.after: Two items in, her only stop is Heroic Charge into a wall — run open-lane patterns, and note Steadfast Presence hands her armour and MR as she drops low, so kill her with poison duration, not a burst window.

edits.before: Use Steadfast Presence to deny any dash escapes — irrelevant here, but she will try to trade short and stack Poppy's passive shield every lane trade
edits.after: Pick her buckler back up for the Iron Ambassador shield, and trade short while Steadfast Presence's low-health armour and MR are at their highest

edits.before: At 2+ items your split-push engine is fully online — Poppy's W blocks dashes you never had, leaving her with only Heroic Charge to stop you, and you can bait and dodge it all game.
edits.after: At 2+ items your split-push engine is fully online — her only stop is Heroic Charge, and if she channels Keeper's Verdict to reset a fight, Fling knocks her up and cancels it outright.

edits.before: - Poppy Heroic Charge: matchup-defining — Wall-pin stun. Keep moving. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Heroic Charge: 14s at rank 1 — the wall pin. Engage once it is spent. - Hammer Shock: 8s, down to 4s maxed — treat her zone as permanent. - Keeper's Verdict: 140s, and Fling cancels the channel.

edits.before: Poppy wastes Heroic Charge — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: It is a channel — your knock-up cancels it and eats a 140s ultimate.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict is a channel — Fling her out of it instead.

edits.before: Proxy + kite — her W doesn’t stop poison, dodge her E. Singed wins the Heroic Charge cooldown windows.
edits.after: Proxy + kite, hug lane centre so her E has no wall. Fling cancels Keeper's Verdict outright.

notes: packet suspectNames for poppy (Insanity Potion, Steadfast Presence) are false positives — both correct. Level-chart flip proposed as one atomic group. Poppy's Hammer Shock and Keeper's Verdict both carry the grounding flag; that is a non-interaction against Singed (no dashes) so it is deliberately not written to the page.
